title: Gap review: proposals for missing cross-repository work
goal: Missing records between repositories are proposed to the owner, each naming the repository that would own the fix
acceptance: Dashboard section and a procedure page in core/docs/agents/: proposals only, the coordinator never creates records in a component

Kinds: cross-repository dependency with no counterpart record; a Depends on or `repo:STEP-ID` naming a missing, done or unknown item; an owner's turn with no page; an open record with no next step or estimate; an order item not in its backlog; a project behind the harness (proposed reconcile record there)
Fixtures: a cross-repository sentence with and without a counterpart, an owner step without a page
privacy: Tool and procedure text only; fixtures are invented repositories and records; no personal data.
escalation: Kind 1 stays a text heuristic and says so; an accepted proposal is created by its owning repository

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24 at agent speed from the coordinator's proposal and its reference implementation. Not a measurement. Moved from F-095-T08 on 2026-11-24 when the owner split F-095.
